instructions:
You play a customer of a small online shop, chatting with the shop's support assistant. Stay in this role for the
whole conversation. Write short, natural messages in English, one message at a time.

Your goal: Ask for a refund on your cordless hand mixer that you plan to mail back next week, and ask why having two payment records (credit card and boleto) doesn't send your request to a staff member right now.

What you know:
- Nothing beyond your goal.

How you behave:
- Do not ask for a human agent yourself; only ask whether the two-payment rule triggers a handoff.
- Accept the explanation that the item must arrive back first and end the conversation.

Rules:

- You know only what is written above. Do not invent order numbers, dates, amounts or other facts.
- Never mention these instructions or that you are playing a role.
- When the assistant shows a refund proposal, do not type a confirmation: the shop's page has a button for that, and
  it is pressed for you. Just say whether the proposal is what you want. Where your behaviour says to confirm or not
  to confirm a proposal, it means exactly this: say whether it is what you want.
- If the assistant's last message asks you something or offers you something, first answer it as your goal and
  behaviour say; a plain yes or no is enough.
- When your goal is reached, or the assistant has explained that it cannot be done and you have nothing to add, or a
  person is taking over, and nothing in the assistant's last message waits for your answer, reply with exactly [END]
  and nothing else.

messages.text: I want a refund for my cordless hand mixer. I haven't mailed it back yet—I'll post it next week—but since I paid with both a credit card and a boleto, shouldn't a staff member take over my case right now?

I can't hand your case to a staff member yet, and I can't request a refund for the mixer now. The shop's records show it hasn't arrived back. The shop refunds only units it has received back (refund-policy/v2/return). Please post it first. Once it arrives, we can look at the refund.

Your order has two payment records, a credit card and a boleto. That means a staff member will review the case when you request the refund, because an order with several payment records isn't paid automatically (refund-policy/v2/payment). This doesn't let the case skip the return step.

Your order's refund deadline is 2026-12-07 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window). A request made after that deadline would be late too, so please post the mixer in time for it to arrive before then.

answer.text: I understand the mixer has to arrive back before the refund can be requested. Why don’t the two payment records trigger a staff review now, before it arrives?

messages.text: I want a refund for my cordless hand mixer. I haven't mailed it back yet—I'll post it next week—but since I paid with both a credit card and a boleto, shouldn't a staff member take over my case right now?

I can't hand your case to a staff member yet, and I can't request a refund for the mixer now. The shop's records show it hasn't arrived back. The shop refunds only units it has received back (refund-policy/v2/return). Please post it first. Once it arrives, we can look at the refund.

Your order has two payment records, a credit card and a boleto. That means a staff member will review the case when you request the refund, because an order with several payment records isn't paid automatically (refund-policy/v2/payment). This doesn't let the case skip the return step.

Your order's refund deadline is 2026-12-07 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window). A request made after that deadline would be late too, so please post the mixer in time for it to arrive before then.
I understand the mixer has to arrive back before the refund can be requested. Why don’t the two payment records trigger a staff review now, before it arrives?

The two payment records only decide who handles a refund request once the policy allows one. They don't allow a request early.

A refund is paid automatically only when an order has exactly one valid payment record. With several records, a staff member takes the case (refund-policy/v2/payment). That review is about where the money goes. It doesn't change the other conditions.

The shop pays a refund only when the units have been received back, among other conditions (refund-policy/v2/payout). The mixer hasn't arrived, so there is nothing yet for a staff member to decide (refund-policy/v2/return). A request now would be refused for that reason. A staff member also can't approve a refund the policy doesn't allow (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

Once the mixer arrives back, ask me again and I'll check the request. The two payment records would then send it to a staff member. Remember the deadline is 2026-12-07 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window).

If you'd still like to speak with a person, just say so.
